emotional_tone: Calm, focused, tactile, premium, zero-distraction. Inspired by Claude AI and Hemingway editor aesthetics.

headings.description: Used for UI headings, dashboard titles, and panel headers.

body.description: Used for UI text, labels, and metadata.

editor.description: Exclusive to the Right Panel (Medium-style Editor). Provides a classic, book-like reading and writing experience.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Dashboard uses a loose Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with generous gaps (gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.split_panels: Left panel (35%, min-w 320px) / Right panel (65%). Divided by a crisp 1px border (border-[#E6E4DD]).
spacing_and_layout.editor_constraints: The writing area inside the right panel MUST have a max-width of 680px and be centered to mimic Medium's distraction-free reading measure.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: UI text strictly left-aligned. Editor body text left-aligned with a ragged right edge.

buttons.primary: Flat solid background (bg-[#1F1E1D]), text-[#FAF9F5], no shadow, rounded-md, px-6 py-3. Hover: slight opacity drop.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid border (border-[#1F1E1D]), text-[#1F1E1D]. Hover: bg-[#1F1E1D] text-[#FAF9F5].

cards.style: Flat, 1px subtle border (border-[#E6E4DD]), background (bg-[#FCFBF8]), NO shadow. Minimalist, geometric.
cards.hover: Subtle background color shift to bg-[#F0EFEB]. No y-axis lift to maintain the 'flat paper' illusion.

inputs.style: Minimalist rectangular fields, 1px border, transparent background, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1F1E1D] rounded-sm.
inputs.tags: Pill-shaped, bg-[#F0EFEB] text-[#4A4541] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border border-[#E6E4DD].

drawer.style: Solid bg-[#FAF9F5] right-side sheet, 1px left border, aggressive drop-shadow-2xl. No glassmorphism.

motion.hover: Color shifts and opacity changes only. Avoid transforms (scale, translate) to preserve the static 'paper' feel.

login_hero.description: Minimalist typewriter desk for the login page hero section.

texture_bg.description: Beige abstract paper texture, can be used as an overlay (opacity-10) or auth screen background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Manrope' and 'Lora' fonts are imported via Google Fonts.
Do NOT use pure white (#FFFFFF) for the main app background; always use #FAF9F5 to match the Claude AI / Hemingway beige vibe.
For the Left Scratchpad Panel, use bg-[#F0EFEB] to give it a slightly recessed, 'sidebar' feel compared to the bright editor.
The Right Editor Panel MUST have a focused max-width 680px content area, centered, with large Lora typography to mimic Medium.
Ensure the split panels scroll independently (h-screen, overflow-y-auto).
Use Phosphor Icons (or Lucide) with a thin stroke-width (1.5) to maintain the minimalist aesthetic.
All form elements (inputs, textareas, dropdowns) must drop the default blue focus rings and use the dark charcoal (#1F1E1D) ring.
Do not use gradients anywhere. Stick to flat, earthy tones.
The 'Gemini Prompt Drawer' should slide out from the right, overlapping the editor, carrying a strong drop shadow.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and inputs.
